body: Trend lens: huwag i-interpret ang mailing as evidence na lumalala suddenly ang pensioner poverty; this article supports an administrative deadline, not that macro claim. Ang useful pattern to watch is different: benefits that require an explicit claim create predictable 'eligible pero unpaid' risk around mailing cycles and cutoffs. If similar claim-dependent programs repeatedly show missed retroactivity, doon tayo may stronger systems-level signal. Paperwork: the least glamorous recurring villain.

claims.text: This mailing and deadline support a claim-dependent administrative-risk interpretation, but do not by themselves establish a worsening macroeconomic trend among pensioners.
claims.basis: Inference from the article's sourced claim requirement and retroactivity cutoff; no longitudinal poverty evidence is provided in the article.
